desc_short: Lumen Field: open football stadium with two great curved steel roof canopies on arched trusses over the sidelines, open end with tall scoreboard, dark gray seats
M&T Bank Stadium: open football bowl with purple seats in three tiers, brick and tan concrete exterior, light steel canopies over the upper sidelines, green field
Memorial Stadium Nebraska: closed college football bowl of bright red seats, tall press box tower on one side, tan concrete exterior, end zone video boards
MetLife Stadium: huge open rectangular bowl with rounded corners, silver aluminum louver facade, four tiers of gray-blue seats, corner video boards, green turf field
Nationals Park: modern glass, steel and white concrete ballpark with blue seats, open outfield toward the river, right field scoreboard, grass field
Neyland Stadium: huge closed college football bowl with orange and white seats, orange and white checkerboard end zones, tall sideline decks, gray concrete exterior
Nissan Stadium: open football bowl with navy blue seats in two decks, tall light towers over the sideline, tan and red brick exterior, end zone video board
Notre Dame Stadium: closed college football bowl of tan brick with arched gates, tall limestone and glass buildings on three sides, dark seats, green field
Ohio Stadium: horseshoe college football bowl with a classical domed rotunda entrance and arches at the closed end, scarlet and gray seats, light concrete exterior
Oriole Park at Camden Yards: brick ballpark with a long eight-story red brick warehouse behind right field, dark green seats, steel truss roof, grass field
Petco Park: sandstone and white ballpark with navy seats, an old four-story brick building built into the left field corner, lawn beyond center field
PNC Park: compact limestone ballpark with navy seats in two decks, open outfield facing the river, low right field wall, grass field
Progressive Field: white steel ballpark with dark blue seats, exposed vertical light towers, tall left field wall and scoreboard, grass field
Providence Park: compact rectangular soccer stadium with green seats, steel canopy roofs, a tall modern east stand, historic brick west facade, green pitch
Rate Field: steel and concrete ballpark with dark green seats, a flat canopy roof over the upper deck, scoreboard with pinwheels in center field, grass field
Raymond James Stadium: open football bowl with red-orange seats, a wooden pirate ship replica in one end zone, large end video boards, tan concrete exterior with ramps
NRG Stadium: rectangular football stadium with a light translucent retractable roof on two large steel trusses, glass curtain walls, red and tan base
Rose Bowl: low elliptical bowl with a continuous rim and light red seats, press box on one side, set among trees, green grass field
Soldier Field: modern steel and glass football bowl inside classical stone Doric colonnades on both long sides, navy blue seats, cantilevered upper deck
Spartan Stadium: closed college football bowl with green and white seats, tall press box tower, tan brick exterior, end zone video board
State Farm Stadium: rounded barrel-shaped stadium clad in vertical ribbed silver metal panels with glass slots, translucent retractable roof panels on top
Talladega Superspeedway: huge steeply banked tri-oval of gray asphalt, long grandstand along the front stretch, pit road, large green infield
Target Field: tan limestone ballpark with dark green seats, a white canopy over the upper deck, large left field scoreboard, tight downtown site
Tropicana Field: domed ballpark with a tilted white cable-supported fabric dome on a light gray round drum, rotunda entrance
U.S. Bank Stadium: angular dark zinc-clad stadium shaped like a ship prow, steeply sloped translucent roof panels, a huge glass wall, sharp asymmetric peaks
United Center: large rectangular arena with rounded corners, red-brown brick and tan exterior with tall windows, glass atrium, flat light gray roof
Williams-Brice Stadium: closed college football bowl with garnet and black seats, upper decks on both sides, gray concrete exterior, end video board
Yankee Stadium: ballpark with a pale limestone exterior of tall arched windows, white roof frieze, navy seats in three decks, outfield bleachers, grass field
